cookies.modalDesc: At Lexbell, we prioritize your data confidentiality. As an offline-first practice management app, we do not sell your personal data or use invasive third-party tracking cookies.

faq.title: Clear answers about Lexbell.
faq.subtitle: Everything about our local privacy model, licensing, performance, and cross-platform compatibility.
faq.q1: What is Lexbell and what is it used for?
faq.a1: Lexbell is a single-user desktop software for independent lawyers, immigration case workers, and rental managers. Manage cases, court deadlines, documents, and clients 100% locally and encrypted on your Mac or Windows computer without cloud reliance or per-user seat fees.
faq.q2: Is Lexbell free and how much does it cost?
faq.a2: You can start completely free with up to 50 active cases, with no time limits and no credit card required. For unlimited case files and advanced features, affordable monthly or annual plans are available without per-seat price gouging.
faq.q3: What is the difference between Clio and Lexbell?
faq.a3: Unlike Clio or web-based practice management platforms that charge expensive per-user monthly subscriptions and store confidential client files on remote servers, Lexbell runs locally on your machine, guarantees attorney-client privilege by design, works 100% offline, and costs a fraction of the price.
faq.q4: How does Lexbell work without internet and without cloud?
faq.a4: Lexbell runs on a Local-First architecture: all your information lives exclusively on your computer and never leaves it or gets sent to external servers. All matter management, deadline calculation, and document tracking features work 100% offline without an internet connection.
faq.q5: Does it work without an internet connection?
faq.a5: Yes. All matter management, deadline calculation, contact directory, and document tracking features work fully offline. Only initial download and store licensing checks require internet.
faq.q6: What happens to my client files if my laptop dies or breaks?
faq.a6: Your data is protected through automated local backups (daily, weekly, or monthly) saved to any drive, external USB, or local directory you choose. You can also export your full database to JSON and restore it onto a new machine in seconds.
faq.q7: Does it work the same on Mac and Windows?
faq.a7: Yes. It delivers the exact same native capabilities across macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel) and Windows (10/11 64-bit), adapting standard keyboard shortcuts: ⌘ on Mac and Ctrl on Windows.
faq.q8: What are the system requirements for Lexbell?
faq.a8: macOS 12 Monterey or later, or 64-bit Windows 10 and 11. It requires less than 150 MB of disk space and runs smoothly on standard modern computers.
faq.q9: Which countries and legal practice areas are supported?
faq.a9: Lexbell is built for solo practitioners and independent professionals. It covers civil, criminal, and labor litigation, immigration petitions and visas, as well as rental leases and property management.
faq.q10: Where can I officially download Lexbell?
faq.a10: Lexbell is officially and securely downloaded from the Apple Mac App Store for macOS and the Microsoft Store for Windows, providing certified code safety and automatic updates.
